title: AI Photo Editing for Couples
summary: AI photo editing for couples: add a photo of you two and turn it into an engagement shoot, a travel photo, an anniversary portrait or an anime still.
body_markdown:
### Can AI edit a photo of me and my partner?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image in Flick and describe the change, such as a new place, new outfits or a painted style, and say that both faces, hair and skin tones must stay exactly as they are.


### Is there a free AI couple photo generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every couple edit on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### Can AI make engagement photos from a selfie?


Yes. Use a clear selfie of the two of you as the reference, then describe the engagement shoot you want, such as a wildflower meadow at golden hour or a city street at night, with the outfits, the pose and the lens.


### Can I combine two separate photos into one couple photo?


Yes. Add a photo of each person as reference images and say which person comes from which photo, then describe the scene they share; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### How do I keep our faces from changing?


Name the features that must stay, such as skin tone, hair, glasses, a beard or freckles, ask for no beautifying or face slimming, and start from a sharp, well lit photo where both faces look toward the camera.


### Can I turn a couple photo into a video?


Yes. Use the edited photo as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small, gentle movement, such as a slow dance, a laugh or a turn toward each other.
